card.name: Letters and digits before a period
card.fires_on: The letter or digit just before a period inside abbreviations like e.g., U.S., P.O., or in section numbers like 2.3.1. It marks a spot where a dot comes next.

modes.label: Abbreviation letters
modes.description: The letter after the first dot in e.g., U.S. or P.O. where another dot follows.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a numbered heading like 2.3.1, before the next dot.

card.writes: It pushes the model to output a period next, as in dotted abbreviations or numbering.
card.plain: It fires inside dotted abbreviations and section numbers, right before the next dot.
